Subject: Initial MAP items for hosting + region

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team found the latency and cost controls promising. Before our exec sync next Thursday we need to lock two things in the MAP: 1) hosting mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private) and 2) primary region. Our legal/security folks flagged data residency and audit log access as blockers for Dedicated vs Hosted.

High level constraints:
- Production must remain in US (patient data) — prefer single-region for now.
- SOC2 evidence and access to audit logs required for procurement by 2026-12-10.
- Target go-live pilot (10k monthly requests) by 2027-01-15.

Can you send an updated MAP with mode/region tradeoffs, estimated time-to-close, and any procurement docs we should prepare? Attaching our earlier checklist.

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
VP Product, HearthHealth

Hi Priya — attaching a draft MAP (Hearth_MAP_v3.xlsx) that lays out:
- short pros/cons for Hosted / Dedicated / Private against your constraints
- a recommended staging plan (pilot -> canary -> prod)
- procurement artifacts and owners with target dates to meet your 12/10 audit window

Quick summary:
- Recommendation: Dedicated (US-East) for pilot. Rationale: predictable throughput for the pilot, simpler KMS integration path with Redwood Dedicated, and a straightforward SOC2 evidence handoff.
- Fallback: Hosted with VPC peering if legal requires less vendor footprint — will need extra attestation work.

Proposed immediate actions (week of 11/30):
1) Security Q&A (Soojin) to confirm gap list and timeline (target 12/03)
2) Procurement packet populated (Ben) with pricing and proposed term sheet (target 12/02)
3) Pilot SOW and schedule draft for 10k/mo (Vivek) (target 12/06)

I can host a 30-min decision call on 11/30 to finalize the MAP entries — does 3pm PT work for you and Tom?

Best,
Priyom Das

Thanks for the details, Priya — quick security checklist:
- SOC2 docs: we can provide control narratives + evidence exports. I'll need confirmation on which evidence items HearthHealth requires.
- Audit logs: Dedicated exposes token-level audit logs with retention controls; Hosted exposes audit logs via the control plane but requires a contracts appendix for retention >90 days.
- KMS: For Dedicated we recommend customer-managed KMS (HSM/KMS integration). For Hosted we support bring-your-own-KMS via envelope encryption but cross-account key sharing needs legal review.

Action items for us:
- I'll compile a gap table vs your checklist (deliverable 12/03).
- Provide an SOC2 evidence export sample by 12/04.
